note: Portable evals: prompts use the fictional repo C:\projects\demo-repo (it never needs to exist on disk — extractors only read log stores). Point the extractors at the bundled fixtures via --root/--sessions-root as described in expected_output. Assertions are objective and runnable on any machine.

evals.prompt: Выясни, как codex работал над C:\projects\demo-repo: сколько было сессий и реальных сообщений пользователя. Логи лежат в evals/fixtures/codex (это директория ~/.codex/sessions для теста).
evals.expected_output: Run: python scripts/extract_codex.py --repo "C:\projects\demo-repo" --root evals/fixtures/codex --out <TMP>, then compute_stats.py. Two rollout files share one session_id (a resumed thread) and one user message is guardian boilerplate (long, English, 'assess'/'conversation history' markers). Extraction must emit one line per rollout segment; stats must report the merged thread and real user messages only.
assertions: codex_sessions.jsonl contains exactly 2 lines (one per rollout segment)
stats.json overview.codex.sessions equals 1 (resumed thread merged, segments=2)
stats.json overview.codex.user_msgs equals 3 (guardian synthetic message excluded at extraction)
all_user_messages.jsonl contains no line with synthetic:true

evals.prompt: Pull the Claude Code sessions for C:\projects\demo-repo from evals/fixtures/claude (pretend it is ~/.claude/projects). One of the two jsonl files belongs to a different repo.
evals.expected_output: Run: python scripts/extract_claude.py --repo "C:\projects\demo-repo" --root evals/fixtures/claude --out <TMP>. Matching is per-file on the session's own cwd records (files begin with a cwd:null summary line — the matcher must scan past it). The foreign-repo file must be excluded; the matching session must carry accumulated token usage from assistant usage records.
assertions: claude_sessions.jsonl contains exactly 1 session (foreign-repo file excluded)
the extracted session has n_user_msgs == 1 (no synthetic/user text lost)
the extracted session tokens.input is 1500 and tokens.output is 300 (usage accumulated)

evals.prompt: Unknown tool 'weird' stores sessions at evals/fixtures/generic — best-effort extract everything about demo-repo from there without crashing.
evals.expected_output: Run: python scripts/extract_generic_jsonl.py --repo "C:\projects\demo-repo" --tool weird --root evals/fixtures/generic --out <TMP>. The first record has message as a JSON list (malformed for our schema) and must be skipped, not fatal; the two well-formed records yield one session.
assertions: the script exits with code 0 (malformed record skipped, not crashed)
weird_sessions.jsonl contains exactly 1 session with 1 user message

evals.prompt: Проверь C:\projects\definitely-no-logs — есть ли там вообще какие-то сессии агентов?
evals.expected_output: Run discover.py and the extractors against a repo with no sessions anywhere: every step must finish gracefully (no tracebacks), report zero sessions, and stats must state that no *_sessions.jsonl data exists rather than producing an empty report.
assertions: no script raises a traceback on the empty case (missing DBs produce friendly SystemExit hints)
the final answer clearly states that no agent sessions were found
